data.long_meaning: Derived from Old French 'Tristrem', Tremaine means 'sad or sorrowful stream'. The name has no direct biblical or spiritual connection, but it carries a sense of depth and emotion. The name Tremaine carries the meaning “Sad or sorrowful stream” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tremaine usually hope their child will grow to embody sad or sorrowful stream and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tremaine total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: טרמיינ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'tamim' meaning 'completeness, entirety, perfection' and the root 'ramah' meaning 'high, loud, strong, mighty'. So 'Tremaine' could mean 'perfect thunder' or 'completely mighty'.

in_greek.name: Θρημαινος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'thremaino' meaning 'to thunder, to make a noise, to roar'. So 'Tremaine' could mean 'one who thunders' or 'one who makes a great noise'.

in_latin.name: Tremainus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'tremere' meaning 'to tremble, to quake, to be agitated, to be filled with fear'. So 'Tremaine' could mean 'one who trembles with fear of the storm' or 'one who is filled with awe of the thunder'.

in_english.name: Tremaine
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old French word 'tremener' meaning 'to tremble, to quake'. So 'Tremaine' could mean 'one who trembles' or 'one who quakes'.
